i18nAdmin.page.description.source: Languages offered to visitors and your institute's wording for every text.

i18nAdmin.common.reload.context: Button that reloads the latest data after a conflict

i18nAdmin.languages.description.source: Choose which languages visitors can switch to and which one is shown first.

i18nAdmin.languages.default.context: Label of the default language select

i18nAdmin.languages.defaultHelp.source: Shown to visitors who have not chosen a language. It must be enabled.

i18nAdmin.languages.detectionHelp.source: For visitors without a saved choice, use their browser's preferred language when it is enabled.

i18nAdmin.languages.readOnly.source: You can view these settings but not change them.

i18nAdmin.languages.noPermission.source: You don't have permission to change language settings.

i18nAdmin.languages.validation.defaultEn.source: The default language must be one of the enabled languages.

i18nAdmin.workspace.description.source: Override the platform wording for your institute. Changes are saved as drafts and go live when you publish.

i18nAdmin.workspace.listLabel.context: Accessible name of the list of texts

i18nAdmin.workspace.empty.title.context: Empty state when the catalog has no texts

i18nAdmin.workspace.empty.description.source: This language has no texts yet. Texts appear here as soon as the platform adds them.

i18nAdmin.workspace.noMatch.description.source: Try another search, module or status, or clear the filters.

i18nAdmin.filter.namespace.context: Filter by area of the app (namespace)

i18nAdmin.filter.status.context: Accessible name of the status filter buttons

i18nAdmin.status.needsReview.context: Status filter: translation must be checked because the English text changed

i18nAdmin.status.overridden.context: Status filter: your institute changed the wording

i18nAdmin.badge.override.context: Badge: your institute's own published wording is served

i18nAdmin.badge.inheritedPlatform.context: Badge: the platform translation is served

i18nAdmin.badge.inheritedSource.context: Badge: no translation, the English text is served

i18nAdmin.badge.draftReset.context: Badge: a draft will remove your override on publish

i18nAdmin.editor.selectPrompt.source: Select a text to see its English source and edit the translation.
i18nAdmin.editor.selectPrompt.context: Shown before a text is selected

i18nAdmin.editor.suggestion.context: Label of an unreviewed platform suggestion

i18nAdmin.editor.useSuggestion.context: Button that copies the suggestion into the editor

i18nAdmin.editor.published.context: Label of the institute's published override

i18nAdmin.editor.overrideNeedsReview.source: The English text changed after this was published. Please check it.

i18nAdmin.editor.draftIsReset.source: Reset to the platform translation when published

i18nAdmin.editor.none.context: Shown when a value does not exist

i18nAdmin.editor.translationLabel.context: Label of the translation field; {language} is the language name

i18nAdmin.editor.reset.context: Button that removes your override when published

i18nAdmin.editor.draftSaved.source: Draft saved. Publish to make it live.

i18nAdmin.editor.resetQueued.source: Reset saved as a draft. Publish to make it live.

i18nAdmin.editor.stale.source: This text was changed by someone else. Reload to see the latest version.

i18nAdmin.editor.readOnly.source: You can view translations but not edit them.

i18nAdmin.problem.tooLong.source: The text is longer than {max} characters.

i18nAdmin.problem.syntax.source: The text has unbalanced braces or quotes. Placeholders look like '{'name'}'.
i18nAdmin.problem.syntax.context: Validation problem. Keep the quoted braces exactly as they are: they display literal braces

i18nAdmin.problem.pluralMissingOther.source: The plural for {name} needs an "other" form.
i18nAdmin.problem.pluralMissingOther.context: Validation problem; {name} is a technical name

i18nAdmin.problem.pluralInvalidCategory.source: "{category}" is not a valid plural form for this language.

i18nAdmin.problem.placeholderMissing.source: The placeholder '{'{name}'}' from the English text is missing.
i18nAdmin.problem.placeholderMissing.context: Validation problem; keep the quoted braces

i18nAdmin.problem.placeholderUnknown.source: The placeholder '{'{name}'}' is not in the English text.
i18nAdmin.problem.placeholderUnknown.context: Validation problem; keep the quoted braces

i18nAdmin.problem.pluralMissing.source: The plural for {name} from the English text is missing.

i18nAdmin.problem.pluralUnknown.source: The plural for {name} is not in the English text.

i18nAdmin.preview.toggle.context: Switch that shows unpublished drafts in this browser tab

i18nAdmin.preview.help.source: Only you see drafts, in this tab, until you reload.

i18nAdmin.preview.banner.source: Previewing unpublished translation drafts. Only you can see them.
i18nAdmin.preview.banner.context: Banner shown across the app while previewing

i18nAdmin.preview.failed.source: Draft preview could not be loaded; showing published texts.
i18nAdmin.preview.failed.context: Banner when the preview catalog failed

i18nAdmin.releases.heading.context: Releases section heading; {language} is the language name

i18nAdmin.releases.description.source: Every publish creates a new version. Rolling back creates a new version too; nothing is deleted.

i18nAdmin.releases.empty.description.source: Visitors see the platform translations until you publish your own wording.

i18nAdmin.releases.rollbackOf.context: Shown on a release created by a rollback

i18nAdmin.publish.open.context: Button that opens the publish dialog

i18nAdmin.publish.description.source: {count, plural, =0 {There are no drafts to publish.} one {# draft will go live as version {version}.} other {# drafts will go live as version {version}.}}

i18nAdmin.publish.descriptionUnknown.source: All drafts for this language will go live as a new version.
i18nAdmin.publish.descriptionUnknown.context: Dialog text when the draft count is unknown

i18nAdmin.rollback.description.source: Version {version}'s texts will be published again as version {next}. Later versions stay in the history.

i18nAdmin.rollback.done.source: Rolled back; now live as version {version}.

i18nAdmin.import.heading.context: Section heading; PO is the gettext translation file format

i18nAdmin.import.description.source: Check the file first. Importing creates drafts only; nothing goes live until you publish.

i18nAdmin.import.dryRun.context: Button that runs a dry run

i18nAdmin.import.additions.source: {count, plural, one {# new translation} other {# new translations}}

i18nAdmin.import.changes.source: {count, plural, one {# changed translation} other {# changed translations}}

i18nAdmin.import.invalid.source: {count, plural, one {# invalid message} other {# invalid messages}}

i18nAdmin.import.unknown.source: {count, plural, one {# unknown key (ignored)} other {# unknown keys (ignored)}}

i18nAdmin.import.blocked.source: Fix the invalid messages in the file before importing.
i18nAdmin.import.blocked.context: Shown when invalid messages block the import

i18nAdmin.import.done.source: {count, plural, one {# draft imported.} other {# drafts imported.}}

i18nAdmin.export.description.source: Download translations as a gettext file.

i18nAdmin.export.done.context: Success message; {file} is a file name

i18nAdmin.course.original.context: Heading of the course's original title and description

i18nAdmin.course.originalLanguage.context: {language} is a language name and code

i18nAdmin.course.languageNotDeclared.context: The course's original language is unknown

i18nAdmin.course.published.source: Published. Visitors using this language now see this title and description.

i18nAdmin.course.unpublished.source: Unpublished. Visitors see the original again.

i18nAdmin.course.stale.source: This translation was changed by someone else. Reload the page to see the latest version.

i18nAdmin.releases.publishedOn.context: Release line: publish date and number of overridden texts

i18nAdmin.import.skipped.source: {count, plural, one {# skipped (empty, needs review or obsolete)} other {# skipped (empty, needs review or obsolete)}}

i18nAdmin.course.unpublishedChanges.context: Badge: the draft differs from the published variant
